tweets.text:
.@markovrobotics is teaching robots to tackle complex manipulation tasks with fewer than ten hours of robot data. Their bet: video already contains most of the physical reality a robot needs to act. 

They use Modal for video processing, world model training, and remote inference.

Legora chose Modal for scalability, low startup latency, and the flexibility to run its large, complex app. With Modal providing reproducible environments at scale, Legora’s agents can now create cases, launch experiments, and analyze results autonomously. 

With engineers managing the process, Legora used this approach to cut agent cost by 30% through smarter compaction and custom tool search.

Read the full post: https://t.co/e4keucL6GH
